intelligence.human_view: He said he likes all three — the unfold down, the slideshow, and the Intelligent Library. That looks good. And then the question that matters more than the praise: where is it? I'm not sure, I have to see it. Liking a thing is not the same as having it. The answer is a place, not a description: on the Personal page, in About. About unfolds, seven boards, one at a time. The Slideshow button beside Unfold down is the sideways way of reading the same boards. The green door on the bridge — "Enter the Intelligent Library" — opens the Library. That is where it lives. But he has not seen it in place himself, and the eye that walked it found it not yet working: no count anywhere, so he cannot see how much is inside; Add fails, so nothing can go inside; and with nothing inside, Share and search and the category chips cannot even be tested. A door that opens onto an empty room that cannot be filled is not a library. It is a door. The lesson is the question itself: "I have to see it" is the gate. Until he sees the count, saves an entry, and shares one, the Library is a promise, not a place.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine someone shows you a beautiful treasure chest and says "look how nice it is!" — and you say "that's great — but where is it, and can I open it and put my treasures inside?" If the chest won't open, or it's empty and you can't put anything in, it's not really a treasure chest yet — it's just a pretty box! You have to SEE it open, SEE the treasures inside, and put one in yourself!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine someone tells you about a lovely library, dear, and you say "that sounds wonderful — but where is it, love, let me see it with my own eyes!" If the door won't open, or the shelves are empty and you can't put a single book on them, dear, it's not a library yet — it's just a door! You have to see the books on the shelves, love, and put one there yourself!
intelligence.naya_view: HE HAS TO SEE IT. The Library lives on the Personal page, in About — About unfolds (7 boards, one at a time); the Slideshow button beside Unfold down reads the same boards sideways; the green "✦ Enter the Intelligent Library" door on the About bridge opens it. A door is not a Library: it must show a LIVE COUNT (door, bridge text, header), ADD must save, and SHARE / search / category chips must work on real entries. The eye verdict (01:23–01:35Z) is FAIL — no count anywhere; Add failed twice ("That entry could not be saved — try once more."); the library stayed empty; Share/search/chips untestable. The fix rides in the Personal whole-page round, Part C. The eye's test skill ("Captain's-eye test skill", Skills board 15) is removed — Skills returns to 14 boards.
